overall.assessment: Freeze IDs-v2 as the quality/efficiency finalist for fresh confirmation. It preserves the important strong-model ranking gains and succeeds on21/21 in this run, with roughly25% lower reconstructed median time and31% lower mean reported cost than gated Flash-reasons. Versus historical lite, cost is about17% higher with slightly lower median total time, while retaining improvements on getaway subject role and failed-heist leader. These aggregate tradeoffs do not require per-request dominance. Remaining conjunction errors prevent a claim of flawless search, and fresh confirmation is still required before declaring an overall winner.
limitations: Earlier IDs-v1 car length failure remains a real failed attempt, not erased by this successful revised-cap run.
Most upstream time and cost are reused projections; current replay latency is not a fresh complete production search measurement.
Contact pool changed24→23 via shared validated format gate; historical lite contact result is not an identically gated comparator.
Unknown format is retained; a gate is not proof that every retained title satisfies sci-fi or other genre semantics.
Final confirmation outputs not inspected during this review.
